protocol: Exploratory 32-feature correction combining existing r16 nuisance trace and 16 evidence coordinates; objective sum AP(delta_logit+delta_trace@w)^2+.01||w||^2 subject to per-fit-CF |delta_trace@w|<=tau*fit-AP-raw-RMS. tau=.1 fixed before dev evaluation in this run. b fitted to natural fit nodes after fixing w.
